title: Selling Plans Policy on Final Value Fee Credits for Chargebacks
content:
## Policy statement

On **Selling Plans**, a chargeback that the seller is liable for and that is debited to the seller's Northloop Payments account earns a chargeback credit on the variable final value fee record of the charged-back order, booked with the order refund credit reason, because the buyer's money has left the seller's balance just as on a refund.

The chargeback credit on an order is fixed only after every fee dispute submitted on that order's variable final value fee record carries a decision.

| Element | What the policy fixes |
|---|---|
| Event that earns the credit | A chargeback the seller is liable for, debited to the seller's Northloop Payments account |
| Fee record credited | The variable final value fee record of the charged-back order |
| Credit reason recorded | Order refund |
| When the credit is fixed | Only once every fee dispute submitted on that fee record carries a decision |
| Observable effect | The credit is listed against that order's fee, dated the day it is booked; the plan's net seller fees billed fall by the credit given |

## Booking tool: `book_chargeback_fee_credit_32d8a153`

**Capability.** Books one seller fee credit against the variable final value fee record of an order whose buyer charged the payment back, with the credit reason given. The record carries the credit before any administration fee, the administration fee withheld and the credit actually given; the plan's net seller fees billed fall by the credit given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_chargeback_fee_credit_32d8a153` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fee_event_ref` | The fee reference number of the order's variable final value fee record being credited, as shown in the seller fee lookup | Id |
| `credit_reason` | Why the credit is given | Exactly one of `order_refund` (money taken back from the seller for the order, by a seller-funded refund or by a chargeback), `order_cancellation` (an order the seller cancelled while it was unshipped), `fee_dispute_upheld` (a seller fee dispute decided in the seller's favour) |
| `gross_credit_amount` | The credit before the administration fee | USD, a non-negative amount to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `refund_admin_fee_amount` | The administration fee withheld from the credit | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent; 0.00 when none |
| `credit_amount` | The credit actually given to the seller | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A receipt listing `credit_id` (the fee reference of the new credit record), `fee_event_ref` (the credited fee record), `order_id` (the order of that fee record), `credit_reason` (the reason recorded), `gross_credit_amount`, `refund_admin_fee_amount` and `credit_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date). A receipt carrying a `credit_id` means the credit is booked.
